capabilities: Number all headings in a document with outline-style numbers
Remove numbering from all headings in a document
Save numbering settings to a document's front matter
Skip numbering for chosen heading levels, separators, or specific files
Render an automatic table of contents
extras: The README states the plugin is a renamed fork of an upstream Obsidian plugin, but the upstream plugin's name appears only as a removed link, so it cannot be identified from the provided text. Detailed settings instructions are deferred to the plugin's settings page rather than the README.
intentEvidence: Renamed plugin to "Auto Heading Numbers" (id: auto-heading-numbers) to differentiate from the upstream fork.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically number or re-number headings in a document.
summary: Heading numbering plugin that adds outline-style numbers like 1.1.2 to the headings of a document, with configurable formats and per-file settings.
